title: Penguin Bill Length Analysis (Python)
text:
Figure 1 is shown below and shows the varying bill lengths in millimeters for different penguin species grouped by sex. From the chart below, while male penguins mostly have longer bills compared to female penguins, the female penguins of the Chinstrap species display the opposite behavior.


Code
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

penguins = load_penguins()
modified_penguins = penguins.dropna(subset='sex').groupby(by=['species', 'sex'])['bill_length_mm'].mean().unstack()

modified_penguins.plot(kind="bar")

plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Bill Length (mm)")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.legend(title="Sex")
plt.grid(axis="y")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()









Data: Palmer Penguins, Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

title: Penguin Bill Length Analysis (R)
text:
Figure 1 is shown below and shows the varying bill lengths in millimeters for different penguin species grouped by sex. From the chart below, while male penguins mostly have longer bills compared to female penguins, the female penguins of the Chinstrap species display the opposite behavior.


Code
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

modified_penguins <- penguins
modified_penguins <- drop_na(modified_penguins, sex)
modified_penguins <- modified_penguins |>
  group_by(species, sex) |>
  summarise(bill_length_mm = mean(bill_length_mm))

modified_penguins <- ggplot(data = modified_penguins, mapping = aes  (x = species,
    y = bill_length_mm,
    fill = sex)) +
    geom_col(position='dodge') +
    xlab("Species") +
    ylab("Bill Length (mm)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 18))
modified_penguins








Figure 1: Bill length of penguins by species.





Data: Palmer Penguins, Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.
